scope: Read-only review of app/admin-link/xpu-delegation/RamLink/WebSocket boundaries, with requested regression and acceptance documentation additions.

findings.detail: Closing an Administrator pane before its async open returned previously left the elevation/connection alive. Root now cancels the pending AdminLink and rejects/closes late returned sockets.

Fault notification previously ran before epoch/worker teardown, leaving the UI marked Online after a runtime worker failure. Six tests now verify teardown, pending cleanup, closed sockets and successful restart before notifications.

regressionTests.fixtures: Controlled Worker with real MessageChannels; actual RamLink code; no browser storage or native elevation.

nativePolicy.addedChecks: 150-character path passes, 151 and 200 reject before IO, 150-character Unicode path passes.

layoutGuidance: Keep XPU 1/XPU 2 mapped to the same existing worker and one separate explicit Windows Administrator capability.
Bind each pane input to its record; avoid routing Administrator input through a shared mutable active target.
Retain pending-open cancellation and late-socket guards, and fence reused pane callbacks by record identity/generation.
Keep quick XPU catalog commands targeted at XPU panes.
notes: This review does not replace the final packaged byte/seal verification.
The forthcoming three-pane UI should be checked through real browser interaction after root finishes its layout changes.
